=== README ===
# Proof Port

Rewriting a custom SAP transaction is easy. Proving the rewrite does the same thing isn't. Proof Port ports one and
lets the old transaction grade the new one, on tests sealed before the port.

Built at EVOLVE, 8090's AI hackathon in Redwood City, 13 to 14 November 2026. This repo was started at the event and
is being built there; its commit history is the record of what was made when.

## What it does

Give it a custom SAP transaction (a module pool: screens, flow logic, ABAP, dictionary) and it hands back a new
implementation on the same database tables, with a proof page saying how closely the two behave.

1. **Extract.** Read the transaction and everything it uses in the customer namespace. SAP's own objects are listed
   by name and never read.
2. **Oracle.** Replay any sequence of screen inputs through the old transaction by batch input and record what the
   screen says and what it leaves in the tables.
3. **Tests.** One agent writes cases from the extract alone; the oracle answers them. The cases are sealed: their
   SHA-256 is committed here before the port starts, and the cases themselves only after grading.
4. **Port.** A second agent, walled off from the cases, builds a RAP business object and an OData V4 service on the
   same tables, with a Fiori Elements app.
5. **Grade.** Every sealed case through the old screen and the new service; compare messages and rows. Then break
   the port on purpose and check the grader goes red.
6. **Proof page.** The score, every difference in words, and what was checked and what wasn't.

## Running it

Python 3 standard library only. The SAP system is reached through ADT (`SAP_URL`, by default a local tunnel), with
credentials in an env file outside the repo (`SAP_ENV`). The agents are Claude Code, run headless.

    python3 factory/extract.py ZCRED              # stage 1: runs/ZCRED/extract/
    python3 factory/tests.py ZCRED                # stage 3a: an agent writes runs/ZCRED/sealed/cases.json
    python3 factory/seal.py ZCRED                 # stage 3b: oracle answers, SHA-256 committed and pushed
    python3 factory/port.py ZCRED ZPP_CR_         # stage 4: a second agent ports it, cases moved to a vault
    python3 factory/vault.py unlock ZCRED
    python3 factory/check.py ZCRED                # did the port agent see any case? does the port call the old code?
    python3 factory/grade.py ZCRED --sealed --out runs/ZCRED/grade.json    # stage 5
    python3 factory/mutate.py ZCRED               # break the port on purpose, grade each break
    python3 factory/proof.py ZCRED                # stage 6: runs/ZCRED/proof.html
    python3 factory/app.py ZCRED                  # the new Fiori Elements app on http://127.0.0.1:8100/

`factory/oracle.py` (stage 2) is used by all of them: it replays screen inputs through the old transaction by batch
input and puts the tables back after every case.

## Built before the event

- The legacy transactions are the input and were made before the event: ZCRED (mine) and ZMM01, from
  [trymytoolkit/sap-retail-z-sandbox](https://github.com/trymytoolkit/sap-retail-z-sandbox) (MIT, Romain Hecquet).
  They live on the SAP system, not in this repo.
- The SAP ABAP developer trial runs on a cloud VM under SAP's licence. It is not in this repo, and neither is any SAP
  standard code.
- An earlier private prototype of this approach was built 4 to 9 November 2026. None of its code is in this repo.
  What carried over is what I learned.
- Saybooks, if shown in the demo, is my separate product (AGPL, saybooks.io) and not part of this submission. The
  same goes for the ECC model client, a separate project on the same SAP system.

## Tools and licences

This list grows as the build does.

- Claude Code and Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic, under Anthropic's commercial terms): the test author and port agents
- Python standard library (Python Software Foundation License)
- SAP ABAP Development Tools REST interface and batch input, on the SAP ABAP developer trial (SAP's trial licence)
- On the SAP system, called but not copied: `/ui2/cl_json` for JSON, `RPY_DYNPRO_READ` for screen definitions,
  RAP and the OData V4 runtime (SAP's trial licence)
- SAPUI5 and Fiori Elements, served by the SAP system to the local app host (SAP's licence; not in this repo)

## Licence

MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

      gv_exists   TYPE abap_bool,
      gv_changed  TYPE abap_bool,
      gv_title    TYPE string,
      ok_code     TYPE sy-ucomm,
      gv_save_ok  TYPE sy-ucomm.

*& Include MZRET_ARTI01 : modules PAI

MODULE exit_0100 INPUT.

MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  gv_save_ok = ok_code. CLEAR ok_code.
  CASE gv_save_ok.
    WHEN 'GO' OR 'ENTER' OR space.
      IF zret_s_art-article_id IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE 'Renseignez un identifiant d''article'(e01) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.
      PERFORM load_article USING zret_s_art-article_id.
      ts_main-activetab = 'TAB1'.
      gv_changed = abap_false.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0200.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANC'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

" Retour / Quitter / Annuler : popup si données non sauvegardées
MODULE exit_0200 INPUT.
  DATA lv_answer TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  IF gv_changed = abap_true.
    CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
      EXPORTING
        titlebar       = 'Quitter'(p01)
        text_question  = 'Les données seront perdues. Quitter ?'(p02)
        text_button_1  = 'Oui'(p03)
        text_button_2  = 'Non'(p04)

        display_cancel_button = space
      IMPORTING

    IF lv_answer <> '1'.

    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  CLEAR: zret_s_art, gt_var, gv_changed.

MODULE user_command_0200 INPUT.
  gv_save_ok = ok_code. CLEAR ok_code.
  CASE gv_save_ok.
    WHEN 'TAB1' OR 'TAB2' OR 'TAB3'.
      ts_main-activetab = gv_save_ok.
    WHEN 'SAVE'.
      PERFORM check_all.
      PERFORM save_article.
    WHEN 'ENTER' OR space.

  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

" Contrôles de l'onglet Données de base (message E = curseur sur le champ)
MODULE check_0210 INPUT.
  gv_changed = abap_true.
  CHECK ok_code = 'SAVE'.
  IF zret_s_art-article_name IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE 'Renseignez le nom de l''article'(e02) TYPE 'E'.

1	*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
2	*& Include MZRET_ARTF01 : formes
3	*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
4	FORM load_article USING VALUE(iv_id) TYPE zret_t_article-article_id.
5	  CLEAR: gs_art_db, gt_var, gv_exists.
6	  SELECT SINGLE * FROM zret_t_article INTO gs_art_db WHERE article_id = iv_id.
7	  IF sy-subrc = 0.
8	    gv_exists = abap_true.
9	    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_art_db TO zret_s_art.
10	    SELECT * FROM zret_t_art_var INTO TABLE gt_var_db WHERE article_id = iv_id.
11	    LOOP AT gt_var_db INTO DATA(ls_db).
12	      CLEAR gs_var. MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_db TO gs_var. APPEND gs_var TO gt_var.
13	    ENDLOOP.
14	    MESSAGE |Article { iv_id } existe : passage en modification| TYPE 'S'.
15	  ELSE.
16	    gv_exists = abap_false.
17	    CLEAR zret_s_art.
18	    zret_s_art-article_id = iv_id.
19	    zret_s_art-base_uom   = 'ST'.
20	    zret_s_art-currency   = 'EUR'.
21	    zret_s_art-active_flag = 'X'.
22	  ENDIF.
23	ENDFORM.
24	
25	" Tous les contrôles, y compris les variantes (EAN à 13 chiffres)
26	FORM check_all.
27	  DATA lv_row TYPE i.
28	  IF zret_s_art-article_name IS INITIAL.
29	    ts_main-activetab = 'TAB1'.
30	    MESSAGE 'Renseignez le nom de l''article'(e02) TYPE 'E'.
31	  ENDIF.
32	  IF zret_s_art-article_type IS INITIAL.
33	    ts_main-activetab = 'TAB1'.
34	    MESSAGE 'Choisissez un type d''article'(e03) TYPE 'E'.
35	  ENDIF.
36	  IF zret_s_art-price <= 0.
37	    ts_main-activetab = 'TAB2'.
38	    MESSAGE 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'(e04) TYPE 'E'.
39	  ENDIF.
40	  LOOP AT gt_var INTO gs_var.
41	    lv_row = sy-tabix.
42	    CHECK gs_var-variant_id IS NOT INITIAL OR gs_var-ean IS NOT INITIAL.
43	    IF gs_var-variant_id IS INITIAL.
44	      ts_main-activetab = 'TAB3'.
45	      MESSAGE |Variante ligne { lv_row } : identifiant manquant| TYPE 'E'.
46	    ENDIF.
47	    IF gs_var-ean IS NOT INITIAL AND ( strlen( gs_var-ean ) <> 13 OR gs_var-ean(13) CN '0123456789' ).
48	      ts_main-activetab = 'TAB3'.
49	      MESSAGE |Variante ligne { lv_row } : l'EAN doit avoir 13 chiffres| TYPE 'E'.
50	    ENDIF.
51	  ENDLOOP.
52	ENDFORM.
53	
54	FORM save_article.
55	  DATA: ls_art TYPE zret_t_article,
56	        lt_var TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zret_t_art_var,
57	        ls_var TYPE zret_t_art_var,
58	        lv_n   TYPE i.
59	  MOVE-CORRESPONDING zret_s_art TO ls_art.
60	  ls_art-mandt = sy-mandt.
61	  IF gv_exists = abap_true.
62	    ls_art-created_by = gs_art_db-created_by.
63	    ls_art-created_on = gs_art_db-created_on.
64	  ELSE.
65	    ls_art-created_by = sy-uname.
66	    ls_art-created_on = sy-datum.
67	  ENDIF.
68	  ls_art-changed_by = sy-uname.
69	  ls_art-changed_on = sy-datum.
70	  LOOP AT gt_var INTO gs_var WHERE variant_id IS NOT INITIAL.
71	    CLEAR ls_var.
72	    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_var TO ls_var.
73	    ls_var-mandt      = sy-mandt.
74	    ls_var-article_id = ls_art-article_id.
75	    IF ls_var-currency IS INITIAL. ls_var-currency = ls_art-currency. ENDIF.
76	    APPEND ls_var TO lt_var.
77	  ENDLOOP.
78	  lv_n = lines( lt_var ).
79	  " L'EAN de l'en-tête (colonne de ZRET_T_ARTICLE) : celui de la première
80	  " variante qui en a un, sinon il reste vide. Sans variante, l'article
81	  " n'a pas d'EAN propre dans ce modèle.
82	  IF ls_art-ean IS INITIAL.
83	    LOOP AT lt_var INTO ls_var WHERE ean IS NOT INITIAL.
84	      ls_art-ean = ls_var-ean.
85	      EXIT.
86	    ENDLOOP.
87	  ENDIF.
88	
89	  MODIFY zret_t_article FROM ls_art.
90	  DELETE FROM zret_t_art_var WHERE article_id = ls_art-article_id.
91	  sy-subrc = 0.
92	  IF lt_var IS NOT INITIAL.
93	    INSERT zret_t_art_var FROM TABLE lt_var.
94	  ENDIF.
95	  IF sy-subrc = 0.
96	    COMMIT WORK.
97	    gv_changed = abap_false.
98	    MESSAGE |Article { ls_art-article_id } sauvegardé ({ lv_n } variante(s))| TYPE 'S'.
99	    CLEAR: zret_s_art, gt_var.
100	    LEAVE TO SCREEN 0100.
101	  ELSE.
102	    ROLLBACK WORK.
103	    MESSAGE 'Erreur à la sauvegarde des variantes'(e05) TYPE 'E'.
104	  ENDIF.
105	ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Include MZRET_ARTF01 : formes
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM load_article USING VALUE(iv_id) TYPE zret_t_article-article_id.
  CLEAR: gs_art_db, gt_var, gv_exists.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM zret_t_article INTO gs_art_db WHERE article_id = iv_id.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    gv_exists = abap_true.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_art_db TO zret_s_art.
    SELECT * FROM zret_t_art_var INTO TABLE gt_var_db WHERE article_id = iv_id.
    LOOP AT gt_var_db INTO DATA(ls_db).
      CLEAR gs_var. MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_db TO gs_var. APPEND gs_var TO gt_var.
    ENDLOOP.
    MESSAGE |Article { iv_id } existe : passage en modification| TYPE 'S'.
  ELSE.
    gv_exists = abap_false.
    CLEAR zret_s_art.
    zret_s_art-article_id = iv_id.
    zret_s_art-base_uom   = 'ST'.
    zret_s_art-currency   = 'EUR'.
    zret_s_art-active_flag = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

" Tous les contrôles, y compris les variantes (EAN à 13 chiffres)
FORM check_all.
  DATA lv_row TYPE i.
  IF zret_s_art-article_name IS INITIAL.
    ts_main-activetab = 'TAB1'.
    MESSAGE 'Renseignez le nom de l''article'(e02) TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
  IF zret_s_art-article_type IS INITIAL.
    ts_main-activetab = 'TAB1'.
    MESSAGE 'Choisissez un type d''article'(e03) TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
  IF zret_s_art-price <= 0.
    ts_main-activetab = 'TAB2'.
    MESSAGE 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'(e04) TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
  LOOP AT gt_var INTO gs_var.
    lv_row = sy-tabix.
    CHECK gs_var-variant_id IS NOT INITIAL OR gs_var-ean IS NOT INITIAL.
    IF gs_var-variant_id IS INITIAL.
      ts_main-activetab = 'TAB3'.
      MESSAGE |Variante ligne { lv_row } : identifiant manquant| TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
    IF gs_var-ean IS NOT INITIAL AND ( strlen( gs_var-ean ) <> 13 OR gs_var-ean(13) CN '0123456789' ).
      ts_main-activetab = 'TAB3'.
      MESSAGE |Variante ligne { lv_row } : l'EAN doit avoir 13 chiffres| TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.

FORM save_article.
  DATA: ls_art TYPE zret_t_article,
        lt_var TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zret_t_art_var,
        ls_var TYPE zret_t_art_var,
        lv_n   TYPE i.
  MOVE-CORRESPONDING zret_s_art TO ls_art.
  ls_art-mandt = sy-mandt.
  IF gv_exists = abap_true.
    ls_art-created_by = gs_art_db-created_by.
    ls_art-created_on = gs_art_db-created_on.
  ELSE.
    ls_art-created_by = sy-uname.
    ls_art-created_on = sy-datum.
  ENDIF.
  ls_art-changed_by = sy-uname.
  ls_art-changed_on = sy-datum.
  LOOP AT gt_var INTO gs_var WHERE variant_id IS NOT INITIAL.
    CLEAR ls_var.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING gs_var TO ls_var.
    ls_var-mandt      = sy-mandt.
    ls_var-article_id = ls_art-article_id.
    IF ls_var-currency IS INITIAL. ls_var-currency = ls_art-currency. ENDIF.
    APPEND ls_var TO lt_var.
  ENDLOOP.
  lv_n = lines( lt_var ).
  " L'EAN de l'en-tête (colonne de ZRET_T_ARTICLE) : celui de la première
  " variante qui en a un, sinon il reste vide. Sans variante, l'article
  " n'a pas d'EAN propre dans ce modèle.
  IF ls_art-ean IS INITIAL.
    LOOP AT lt_var INTO ls_var WHERE ean IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_art-ean = ls_var-ean.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

  MODIFY zret_t_article FROM ls_art.
  DELETE FROM zret_t_art_var WHERE article_id = ls_art-article_id.
  sy-subrc = 0.
  IF lt_var IS NOT INITIAL.
    INSERT zret_t_art_var FROM TABLE lt_var.
  ENDIF.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    COMMIT WORK.
    gv_changed = abap_false.
    MESSAGE |Article { ls_art-article_id } sauvegardé ({ lv_n } variante(s))| TYPE 'S'.
    CLEAR: zret_s_art, gt_var.
    LEAVE TO SCREEN 0100.
  ELSE.
    ROLLBACK WORK.
    MESSAGE 'Erreur à la sauvegarde des variantes'(e05) TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

"""Create, change, activate and publish RAP objects through ADT. This is the port agent's tool.

    python3 factory/rap.py put KIND NAME FILE [--desc TEXT] [--part implementations]
    python3 factory/rap.py activate KIND:NAME [KIND:NAME ...]
    python3 factory/rap.py binding NAME SERVICE_DEFINITION [--desc TEXT]
    python3 factory/rap.py publish NAME
    python3 factory/rap.py get KIND NAME [--part implementations]
    python3 factory/rap.py delete KIND NAME
    python3 factory/rap.py sql "SELECT ..."

KIND is DDLS (CDS view), BDEF (behavior definition), CLAS (class; --part implementations is the local types
include of a behavior pool), DDLX (metadata extension), SRVD (service definition) or SRVB (service binding).
Objects are local ($TMP). Credentials come from SAP_ENV, the agent's own SAP user.
"""
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import urllib.parse

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import sap  # noqa: E402

KINDS = {
    "DDLS": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/ddl/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddlSource+xml",
             'ddl:ddlSource xmlns:ddl="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ddlsources"', "DDLS/DF"),
    "BDEF": ("/sap/bc/adt/bo/behaviordefinitions", "application/vnd.sap.adt.blues.v1+xml",
             'blue:blueSource xmlns:blue="http://www.sap.com/wbobj/blue"', "BDEF/BDO"),
    "CLAS": ("/sap/bc/adt/oo/classes", "application/vnd.sap.adt.oo.classes.v4+xml",
             'class:abapClass xmlns:class="http://www.sap.com/adt/oo/classes" class:final="true" '
             'class:visibility="public"', "CLAS/OC"),
    "DDLX": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/ddlx/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddic.ddlx.v1+xml",
             'ddlx:ddlxSource xmlns:ddlx="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ddlxsources"', "DDLX/EX"),
    "SRVD": ("/sap/bc/adt/ddic/srvd/sources", "application/vnd.sap.adt.ddic.srvd.v1+xml",
             'srvd:srvdSource xmlns:srvd="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/srvdsources" srvd:srvdSourceType="S"',
             "SRVD/SRV"),
    "SRVB": ("/sap/bc/adt/businessservices/bindings", "application/vnd.sap.adt.businessservices.servicebinding.v2+xml",
             None, "SRVB/SVB"),
}


def q(name):
    return urllib.parse.quote(name.lower(), safe="")


def uri(kind, name):
    return f"{KINDS[kind][0]}/{q(name)}"


def source_uri(kind, name, part=None):
    if kind == "CLAS" and part:
        return f"{uri(kind, name)}/includes/{part}"
    return f"{uri(kind, name)}/source/main"


def exists(s, kind, name):
    try:
        s.request("GET", uri(kind, name), accept="*/*")
        return True
    except sap.SapError as e:
        if "HTTP 404" in str(e):
            return False
        raise


def create(s, kind, name, desc):
    collection, ctype, root, adt_type = KINDS[kind]
    tag = root.split()[0]
    body = (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><{root} xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" '
            f'adtcore:description="{desc}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="{adt_type}" '
            f'adtcore:masterLanguage="EN" adtcore:responsible="{s.user}">'
            f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{sap.PACKAGE}"/></{tag}>')
    s.post(collection, body, content_type=ctype)


def lock(s, object_uri):
    _, _, text = s.post(f"{object_uri}?_action=LOCK&accessMode=MODIFY", stateful=True,
                        accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml;charset=UTF-8;dataname=com.sap.adt.lock.result")
    return urllib.parse.quote(re.search(r"<LOCK_HANDLE>(.*?)</LOCK_HANDLE>", text).group(1), safe="")


def unlock(s, object_uri, handle):
    try:
        s.post(f"{object_uri}?_action=UNLOCK&lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)
    except sap.SapError as e:
        print(f"warning: unlock failed: {e}")


def put(s, kind, name, text, desc=None, part=None):
    if not exists(s, kind, name):
        create(s, kind, name, desc or name)
    handle = lock(s, uri(kind, name))
    try:
        s.request("PUT", f"{source_uri(kind, name, part)}?lockHandle={handle}", text,
                  content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8", stateful=True)
    finally:
        unlock(s, uri(kind, name), handle)


def get(s, kind, name, part=None):
    return s.source(source_uri(kind, name, part))


def activate(s, objects):
    refs = "".join(f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:uri="{uri(k, n)}" adtcore:name="{n.upper()}"/>'
                   for k, n in objects)
    body = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><adtcore:objectReferences '
            f'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">{refs}</adtcore:objectReferences>')
    _, _, text = s.post("/sap/bc/adt/activation?method=activate&preauditRequested=true", body,
                        content_type="application/xml")
    messages = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"<msg\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</msg>", text, re.S):
        attrs, inner = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        kind = re.search(r'type="(\w)"', attrs)
        where = re.search(r'href="([^"]*)"', attrs)
        txt = " ".join(re.findall(r"<txt>(.*?)</txt>", inner, re.S))
        messages.append(f"{kind.group(1) if kind else '?'} {urllib.parse.unquote(where.group(1)) if where else ''}: "
                        f"{txt}")
    return messages


def binding(s, name, srvd, desc=None):
    collection, ctype, _, _ = KINDS["SRVB"]
    body = (f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><srvb:serviceBinding '
            f'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" xmlns:srvb="http://www.sap.com/adt/ddic/ServiceBindings" '
            f'srvb:releaseSupported="false" srvb:published="false" srvb:bindingCreated="true" '
            f'adtcore:description="{desc or name}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="SRVB/SVB" '
            f'adtcore:masterLanguage="EN" adtcore:responsible="{s.user}">'
            f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{sap.PACKAGE}"/>'
            f'<srvb:services srvb:name="{name.upper()}"><srvb:content srvb:version="0001">'
            f'<srvb:serviceDefinition adtcore:name="{srvd.upper()}"/></srvb:content></srvb:services>'
            f'<srvb:binding srvb:type="ODATA" srvb:version="V4" srvb:category="0">'
            f'<srvb:implementation adtcore:name=""/></srvb:binding></srvb:serviceBinding>')
    s.post(collection, body, content_type=ctype)


def publish(s, name):
    body = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><adtcore:objectReferences '
            'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">'
            f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:type="SRVB/SVB" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}"/>'
            '</adtcore:objectReferences>')
    _, _, text = s.post(f"/sap/bc/adt/businessservices/odatav4/publishjobs?servicename={name.upper()}"
                        "&serviceversion=0001", body, content_type="application/xml", accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml")
    return sap.short(text, 600)


def delete(s, kind, name):
    handle = lock(s, uri(kind, name))
    s.request("DELETE", f"{uri(kind, name)}?lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)


def main(argv):
    args, opts = [], {}
    it = iter(argv)
    for a in it:
        if a.startswith("--"):
            opts[a[2:]] = next(it)
        else:
            args.append(a)
    s = sap.Sap()
    cmd = args[0]
    prefix = os.environ.get("RAP_PREFIX", "ZPP_").upper()
    names = [a.split(":", 1)[-1] for a in args[1:3]] if cmd in ("put", "get", "delete", "binding") else \
        [a.split(":", 1)[-1] for a in args[1:]] if cmd in ("activate", "publish") else []
    if cmd in ("put", "get", "delete") and len(args) > 2:
        names = [args[2]]
    bad = [n for n in names if not n.upper().startswith(prefix)]
    if bad:
        print(f"refused: names must start with {prefix}: {bad}")
        return 2
    if cmd == "put":
        kind, name, path = args[1].upper(), args[2], args[3]
        with open(path) as f:
            put(s, kind, name, f.read(), opts.get("desc"), opts.get("part"))
        print(f"saved {kind} {name.upper()} (not active yet: run activate)")
    elif cmd == "get":
        print(get(s, args[1].upper(), args[2], opts.get("part")))
    elif cmd == "activate":
        objects = [tuple(a.split(":", 1)) for a in args[1:]]
        messages = activate(s, [(k.upper(), n) for k, n in objects])
        errors = [m for m in messages if m.startswith(("E", "A"))]
        print("\n".join(messages) if messages else "activated")
        return 1 if errors else 0
    elif cmd == "binding":
        binding(s, args[1], args[2], opts.get("desc"))
        print(f"created service binding {args[1].upper()} for {args[2].upper()}; activate it, then publish")
    elif cmd == "publish":
        print(publish(s, args[1]))
    elif cmd == "delete":
        delete(s, args[1].upper(), args[2])
        print("deleted")
    elif cmd == "sql":
        print(json.dumps(s.sql(args[1], rows=int(opts.get("rows", 500))), indent=1))
    else:
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

"""Stage 2: the oracle. Replay screen inputs through the old transaction and record what it does.

A case is a list of steps. Each step names a screen, the fields typed into it and the function code pressed:

    {"id": "c001", "steps": [
        {"screen": "0100", "fields": {"GV_KUNNR": "C100"}, "ok": "/00"},
        {"screen": "0200", "fields": {"GV_NEW_LIMIT": "7000"}, "ok": "SAVE"}]}

Values are typed as a user would type them, in the SAP user's own number and date notation. The report on SAP
takes a snapshot of the transaction's tables first, and for every case runs CALL TRANSACTION by batch input,
records the messages and every row of the tables afterwards, then puts the snapshot back. So each case starts from
the same data, and the tables end as they began.

    python3 factory/oracle.py ZCRED cases.json [out.json]
"""
import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import abap  # noqa: E402
import sap  # noqa: E402

BATCH = 40

TYPES = r"""
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_base,
         tab  TYPE tabname,
         data TYPE REF TO data,
       END OF ty_base.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_msg,
         type   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
         id     TYPE symsgid,
         number TYPE string,
         text   TYPE string,
         screen TYPE string,
       END OF ty_msg.
DATA: gt_bdc  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bdcdata,
      gt_msg  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bdcmsgcoll,
      gt_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_base.
"""

FORMS = r"""
FORM snapshot USING iv_tab TYPE tabname.
  DATA lr TYPE REF TO data.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  CREATE DATA lr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_tab).
  ASSIGN lr->* TO <lt>.
  SELECT * FROM (iv_tab) INTO TABLE <lt>.
  APPEND VALUE #( tab = iv_tab data = lr ) TO gt_base.
ENDFORM.

FORM restore.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  LOOP AT gt_base INTO DATA(ls_base).
    ASSIGN ls_base-data->* TO <lt>.
    DELETE FROM (ls_base-tab).
    INSERT (ls_base-tab) FROM TABLE <lt>.
  ENDLOOP.
  COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
ENDFORM.

FORM dyn USING iv_prog TYPE csequence iv_dynp TYPE csequence.
  APPEND VALUE #( program = iv_prog dynpro = iv_dynp dynbegin = 'X' ) TO gt_bdc.
ENDFORM.

FORM fld USING iv_name TYPE csequence iv_value TYPE csequence.
  APPEND VALUE #( fnam = iv_name fval = iv_value ) TO gt_bdc.
ENDFORM.

FORM run USING iv_id TYPE csequence.
  DATA: lv_subrc TYPE i,
        lv_json  TYPE string,
        lv_text  TYPE string,
        lv_n     TYPE i,
        lr       TYPE REF TO data.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  CLEAR gt_msg.
  DATA(ls_opt) = VALUE ctu_params( dismode = 'N' updmode = 'S' defsize = 'X' ).
  CALL TRANSACTION '{tcode}' USING gt_bdc OPTIONS FROM ls_opt MESSAGES INTO gt_msg.
  lv_subrc = sy-subrc.
  DATA(ls_last) = VALUE ty_msg( type = sy-msgty id = sy-msgid number = sy-msgno ).
  IF sy-msgty IS NOT INITIAL.
    MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'I' NUMBER sy-msgno WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO ls_last-text.
  ENDIF.
  lv_json = |\{"id":"{ iv_id }","subrc":{ lv_subrc },"last":| && /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_last )
    && `,"messages":[`.
  LOOP AT gt_msg INTO DATA(ls_m).
    MESSAGE ID ls_m-msgid TYPE 'I' NUMBER ls_m-msgnr WITH ls_m-msgv1 ls_m-msgv2 ls_m-msgv3 ls_m-msgv4
      INTO lv_text.
    IF lv_n > 0.
      lv_json = lv_json && `,`.
    ENDIF.
    lv_n = lv_n + 1.
    lv_json = lv_json && /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = VALUE ty_msg( type = ls_m-msgtyp id = ls_m-msgid
      number = ls_m-msgnr text = lv_text screen = |{ ls_m-dyname } { ls_m-dynumb }| ) ).
  ENDLOOP.
  lv_json = lv_json && `],"tables":{`.
  lv_n = 0.
  LOOP AT gt_base INTO DATA(ls_base).
    CREATE DATA lr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (ls_base-tab).
    ASSIGN lr->* TO <lt>.
    SELECT * FROM (ls_base-tab) INTO TABLE <lt>.
    IF lv_n > 0.
      lv_json = lv_json && `,`.
    ENDIF.
    lv_n = lv_n + 1.
    lv_json = lv_json && |"{ ls_base-tab }":| && /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = <lt> ).
  ENDLOOP.
  lv_json = lv_json && `}}`.
  PERFORM out USING 'CASE' lv_json.
  PERFORM restore.
  CLEAR gt_bdc.
ENDFORM.
"""


def lit(value):
    return "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'"


def case_abap(case, program):
    lines = []
    for step in case["steps"]:
        lines.append(f"PERFORM dyn USING {lit(step.get('program', program))} {lit(step['screen'])}.")
        for name, value in step.get("fields", {}).items():
            lines.append(f"PERFORM fld USING {lit(name)} {lit(value)}.")
        lines.append(f"PERFORM fld USING 'BDC_OKCODE' {lit(step.get('ok', '/00'))}.")
    lines.append(f"PERFORM run USING {lit(case['id'])}.")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def load_summary(tcode):
    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "runs", tcode, "extract", "summary.json")
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)


def replay(tcode, cases, s=None):
    """Run cases through the old transaction. Returns {case id: {"subrc", "messages", "tables"}}."""
    s = s or sap.Sap()
    summary = load_summary(tcode)
    snapshot = "\n".join(f"PERFORM snapshot USING {lit(t)}." for t in summary["tables"])
    results = {}
    for i in range(0, len(cases), BATCH):
        batch = cases[i:i + BATCH]
        body = snapshot + "\n" + "\n".join(case_abap(c, summary["program"]) for c in batch)
        records = abap.run(s, os.environ.get("ORACLE_REPORT", "ZPP_ORACLE"), body + "\n" + FORMS.replace("{tcode}", summary["tcode"]), types=TYPES)
        for kind, payload in records:
            if kind == "CASE":
                r = json.loads(payload)
                r["messages"] = [{k.lower(): v for k, v in m.items()} for m in r["messages"]]
                r["last"] = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r["last"].items()}
                results[r.pop("id")] = r
        missing = [c["id"] for c in batch if c["id"] not in results]
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit(f"no result for {missing}; see python3 factory/dumps.py")
    return results


if __name__ == "__main__":
    tcode, path = sys.argv[1].upper(), sys.argv[2]
    with open(path) as f:
        cases = json.load(f)
    out = replay(tcode, cases)
    text = json.dumps(out, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
    if len(sys.argv) > 3:
        with open(sys.argv[3], "w") as f:
            f.write(text)
    else:
        print(text)

1	"""Stage 5: grade the port against the old transaction.
2	
3	Every case goes through the old screen (the oracle, run fresh) and through the new service (the port's driver),
4	each starting from the same data. Then the error messages and every table row are compared.
5	
6	    python3 factory/grade.py ZCRED CASES.json [--out report.json]      cases of your own
7	    python3 factory/grade.py ZCRED --sealed [--out report.json]         the sealed cases (factory only)
8	
9	The driver is runs/<TCODE>/port/driver.py with a function run(client, steps). It gets an odata.Client for the new
10	service (runs/<TCODE>/port/service.json names the service root) and the steps of one case, and does what a user of
11	the new app would do to achieve the same. It returns nothing; the grader reads the messages from the client's calls
12	and the rows from the database.
13	"""
14	import hashlib
15	import importlib.util
16	import json
17	import os
18	import sys
19	import time
20	
21	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
22	import abap  # noqa: E402
23	import odata  # noqa: E402
24	import oracle  # noqa: E402
25	import sap  # noqa: E402
26	
27	ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
28	VOLATILE_ROLLS = {"TIMESTAMP", "TIMESTAMPL", "TZNTSTMPS", "TZNTSTMPL", "SYUZEIT", "UZEIT"}
29	STOPPED = ("00", "344")  # batch input: the steps ran out on a screen, so the user stopped there
30	
31	
32	def load_json(path):
33	    with open(path) as f:
34	        return json.load(f)
35

37	def volatile_fields(tcode):
38	    d = load_json(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "extract", "dictionary.json"))
39	    out = {}
40	    for table, t in d["tables"].items():
41	        out[table] = {f["FIELDNAME"] for f in t["fields"]
42	                      if f["ROLLNAME"] in VOLATILE_ROLLS or f["DATATYPE"] == "TIMS"
43	                      # a time stamp typed directly, without a data element: DEC 15,0 or DEC 21,7
44	                      or (f["DATATYPE"] == "DEC" and (int(f["LENG"]), int(f["DECIMALS"])) in ((15, 0), (21, 7)))}
45	    return out
46	
47	
48	def table_fields(tcode):
49	    d = load_json(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "extract", "dictionary.json"))
50	    return {t: [f["FIELDNAME"] for f in v["fields"] if not f["FIELDNAME"].startswith(".")] for t, v in
51	            d["tables"].items() if v["class"] == "TRANSP"}
52	
53	
54	def read_tables(s, fields):
55	    return {t: s.sql(f"SELECT {', '.join(fl)} FROM {t}") for t, fl in fields.items()}
56	
57	
58	def lit(v):
59	    return "'" + str(v).replace("'", "''") + "'"
60	
61	
62	def after_report(baseline, fields):
63	    """One report per case: write every row as the case left it, then put the baseline back. Reading through the
64	    data preview instead runs out of generated programs in one session after a few cases."""
65	    lines = ["DATA lv_json TYPE string."]
66	    for table in baseline:
67	        t = table.lower()
68	        lines.append(f"DATA lt_{t}_now TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF {t}.")
69	        lines.append(f"SELECT * FROM {t} INTO TABLE lt_{t}_now.")
70	        lines.append(f"lv_json = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_{t}_now ).")
71	        lines.append(f"PERFORM out USING '{table}' lv_json.")
72	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n" + restore_report(baseline, fields)
73	
74	
75	def restore_report(baseline, fields):
76	    lines = []
77	    for table, rows in baseline.items():
78	        lines.append(f"DATA lt_{table.lower()} TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF {table.lower()}.")
79	        for r in rows:
80	            assigns = " ".join(f"{f.lower()} = {lit(r[f])}" for f in fields[table] if f != "MANDT" and r[f] != "")
81	            lines.append(f"APPEND VALUE {table.lower()}( {assigns} ) TO lt_{table.lower()}.")
82	        lines.append(f"DELETE FROM {table.lower()}.")
83	        lines.append(f"INSERT {table.lower()} FROM TABLE lt_{table.lower()}.")
84	    lines.append("COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.")
85	    return "\n".join(lines)
86	
87	
88	def norm(value):
89	    """Compare numbers as numbers: the oracle writes 7000.00 as 7000.0, the database as '7000.00'."""
90	    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
91	        return repr(float(value))
92	    text = str(value).strip()
93	    try:
94	        if text and any(c.isdigit() for c in text) and text.replace(".", "", 1).replace("-", "", 1).isdigit():
95	            return repr(float(text))
96	    except ValueError:
97	        pass
98	    return text
99	
100	
101	def normalise_rows(rows, volatile):
102	    out = []
103	    for r in rows:
104	        row = {}
105	        for k, v in r.items():
106	            if k == "MANDT":
107	                continue
108	            row[k] = ("<set>" if norm(v) not in ("", "0.0") else "<empty>") if k in volatile else norm(v)
109	        out.append(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True))
110	    return sorted(out)
111	
112	
113	def errors(messages):
114	    out = []
115	    for m in messages:
116	        if (m.get("id"), str(m.get("number"))) == STOPPED:
117	            continue
118	        if m.get("type") in ("E", "A", "X"):
119	            out.append(m.get("text", "").strip())
120	    return sorted(set(out))
121	
122	
123	def compare(old, new, vol):
124	    diffs = []
125	    old_err, new_err = errors(old["messages"]), errors(new["messages"])
126	    if old_err != new_err:
127	        diffs.append({"what": "messages", "old": old_err, "new": new_err})
128	    for table in old["tables"]:
129	        a = normalise_rows(old["tables"][table], vol.get(table, set()))
130	        b = normalise_rows(new["tables"].get(table, []), vol.get(table, set()))
131	        if a != b:
132	            only_old = [json.loads(x) for x in a if x not in b]
133	            only_new = [json.loads(x) for x in b if x not in a]
134	            diffs.append({"what": f"rows of {table}", "old_only": only_old, "new_only": only_new})
135	    return diffs
136	
137	
138	def load_driver(tcode):
139	    path = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port", "driver.py")
140	    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("driver", path)
141	    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
142	    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
143	    return mod
144	
145	
146	class RecordingClient(odata.Client):
147	    """Keeps every message the service sent during one case."""
148	
149	    def __init__(self, *a, **kw):
150	        super().__init__(*a, **kw)
151	        self.seen = []
152	
153	    def call(self, method, path, data=None, headers=None):
154	        r = super().call(method, path, data, headers)
155	        self.seen.extend(r.messages)
156	        return r
157	
158	    def ui(self, type_, text):
159	        r = super().ui(type_, text)
160	        self.seen.append({"type": type_, "text": text, "from": "ui"})
161	        return r
162	
163	
164	def grade(tcode, cases, report_name="ZPP_RESTORE", oracle_report="ZPP_ORACLE_G", s=None, sealed_answers=None):
165	    s = s or sap.Sap()
166	    fields = table_fields(tcode)
167	    vol = volatile_fields(tcode)
168	    os.environ["ORACLE_REPORT"] = oracle_report
169	    t0 = time.time()
170	    old = oracle.replay(tcode, cases, s)
171	    t_old = time.time() - t0
172	    baseline = read_tables(s, fields)
173	    s.write_program(report_name, abap.build(report_name, after_report(baseline, fields)))
174	    service = load_json(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port", "service.json"))
175	    driver = load_driver(tcode)
176	    results = []
177	    t1 = time.time()
178	    for case in cases:
179	        client = RecordingClient(service["root"], s)
180	        crash = None
181	        try:
182	            driver.run(client, case["steps"])
183	        except Exception as e:  # the driver failing is a result too
184	            crash = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
185	        rows = {k: json.loads(v) for k, v in abap.parse(s.run_program(report_name)) if k in fields}
186	        new = {"messages": client.seen, "tables": rows}
187	        diffs = compare(old[case["id"]], new, vol)
188	        if crash:
189	            diffs.insert(0, {"what": "driver crashed", "error": crash})
190	        drift = None
191	        if sealed_answers is not None:
192	            sealed_old = sealed_answers.get(case["id"])
193	            if sealed_old is None or compare(sealed_old, old[case["id"]], vol):
194	                drift = "the old transaction answered differently than when the cases were sealed"
195	        results.append({"id": case["id"], "intent": case.get("intent", ""), "pass": not diffs, "diffs": diffs,
196	                        "old_messages": errors(old[case["id"]]["messages"]), "new_messages": client.seen,
197	                        "drift": drift})
198	    t_new = time.time() - t1
199	    after = read_tables(s, fields)
200	    clean = all(normalise_rows(after[t], vol[t]) == normalise_rows(baseline[t], vol[t]) for t in fields)
201	    passed = sum(r["pass"] for r in results)
202	    return {"tcode": tcode, "cases": len(cases), "passed": passed, "failed": len(cases) - passed,
203	            "drift": sum(1 for r in results if r["drift"]), "tables_restored": clean,
204	            "seconds_old": round(t_old, 1), "seconds_new": round(t_new, 1), "results": results}
205	
206	
207	def main(argv):
208	    tcode = argv[0].upper()
209	    out = None
210	    if "--out" in argv:
211	        out = argv[argv.index("--out") + 1]
212	    sealed_answers = None
213	    if "--sealed" in argv:
214	        bundle_path = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "sealed", "bundle.json")
215	        with open(bundle_path, "rb") as f:
216	            raw = f.read()
217	        bundle = json.loads(raw)
218	        cases, sealed_answers = bundle["cases"], bundle["answers"]
219	        print(f"sealed bundle sha256 {hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}")
220	        report_name, oracle_report = "ZPP_RESTORE", "ZPP_ORACLE_G"
221	    else:
222	        cases = load_json(argv[1])
223	        report_name, oracle_report = "ZPP_RESTORE_P", "ZPP_ORACLE_P"
224	    report = grade(tcode, cases, report_name, oracle_report, sealed_answers=sealed_answers)
225	    text = json.dumps(report, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
226	    if out:
227	        with open(out, "w") as f:
228	            f.write(text)
229	    print(f"{report['passed']} of {report['cases']} cases behave the same; tables restored: "
230	          f"{report['tables_restored']}; drift: {report['drift']}")
231	    for r in report["results"]:
232	        if not r["pass"]:
233	            print(f"- {r['id']} {r['intent']}")
234	            for d in r["diffs"]:
235	                print(f"    {json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]}")
236	    return 0 if report["failed"] == 0 else 1
237	
238	
239	if __name__ == "__main__":
240	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

1	"""A small OData V4 client for the new service, handed to the port's driver by the grader.
2	
3	The driver never sees credentials: it gets a Client and calls get, post, patch and delete with paths relative to the
4	service root. Every call returns a Response with the status, the JSON body and the messages the service sent (error
5	body and details, and the sap-messages header), each as {"type": "E"|"W"|"S"|"I", "text": ...}.
6	"""
7	import json
8	import os
9	import sys
10	
11	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
12	import sap  # noqa: E402
13	
14	SEVERITY = {1: "S", 2: "I", 3: "W", 4: "E"}
15	
16	
17	class Response:
18	    def __init__(self, status, body, messages):
19	        self.status, self.body, self.messages = status, body, messages
20	
21	    @property
22	    def ok(self):
23	        return 200 <= self.status < 300
24	
25	    def __repr__(self):
26	        return f"Response({self.status}, messages={self.messages})"
27	
28	
29	class Client:
30	    def __init__(self, service_root, s=None):
31	        self.s = s or sap.Sap()
32	        if "://" not in service_root:  # a path on the factory's own SAP system
33	            service_root = self.s.url + "/" + service_root.lstrip("/")
34	        self.root = service_root.rstrip("/") + "/"
35	        self.csrf = None
36	
37	    def _messages(self, headers, body):
38	        out = []
39	        err = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
40	        if err:
41	            details = err.get("details") or []
42	            if not details:
43	                out.append({"type": "E", "text": err.get("message", "")})
44	            for d in details:
45	                out.append({"type": SEVERITY.get(d.get("@Common.numericSeverity"), "E"), "text": d.get("message", "")})
46	            if details and err.get("message") and err["message"] not in [d.get("message") for d in details]:
47	                out.insert(0, {"type": "E", "text": err["message"]})
48	        raw = headers.get("sap-messages") if headers else None
49	        if raw:
50	            try:
51	                for m in json.loads(raw):
52	                    out.append({"type": SEVERITY.get(m.get("numericSeverity"), "I"), "text": m.get("message", "")})
53	            except ValueError:
54	                pass
55	        return out
56	
57	    def call(self, method, path, data=None, headers=None):
58	        if method != "GET" and not self.csrf:
59	            self._fetch_csrf()
60	        url = self.root + path.lstrip("/")
61	        hdrs = {"Accept": "application/json", "Authorization": self.s.auth}
62	        if self.csrf:
63	            hdrs["X-CSRF-Token"] = self.csrf
64	        body = None
65	        if data is not None:
66	            body = json.dumps(data).encode()
67	            hdrs["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
68	        hdrs.update(headers or {})
69	        import urllib.request
70	        import urllib.error
71	        req = urllib.request.Request(url + ("&" if "?" in url else "?") + "sap-client=" + self.s.client,
72	                                     data=body, method=method, headers=hdrs)
73	        try:
74	            with self.s.opener.open(req, timeout=120) as resp:
75	                status, h, text = resp.status, resp.headers, resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
76	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
77	            status, h, text = e.code, e.headers, e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
78	            if status == 403 and "csrf" in (e.headers.get("x-csrf-token", "") or "").lower():
79	                self.csrf = None
80	                self._fetch_csrf()
81	                return self.call(method, path, data, headers)
82	        try:
83	            parsed = json.loads(text) if text.strip() else {}
84	        except ValueError:
85	            parsed = {"raw": text[:2000]}
86	        return Response(status, parsed, self._messages(h, parsed))
87	
88	    def _fetch_csrf(self):
89	        import urllib.request
90	        req = urllib.request.Request(self.root + "?sap-client=" + self.s.client,
91	                                     headers={"X-CSRF-Token": "Fetch", "Authorization": self.s.auth,
92	                                              "Accept": "application/json"})
93	        with self.s.opener.open(req, timeout=60) as resp:
94	            self.csrf = resp.headers.get("x-csrf-token")
95	
96	    def ui(self, type_, text):
97	        """Record a message the app's UI shows before calling the service (input format only, never a rule)."""
98	        self.ui_messages = getattr(self, "ui_messages", []) + [{"type": type_, "text": text, "from": "ui"}]
99	        return Response(0, {}, [{"type": type_, "text": text}])
100	
101	    def get(self, path, **kw):
102	        return self.call("GET", path, **kw)
103	
104	    def post(self, path, data=None, **kw):
105	        return self.call("POST", path, data if data is not None else {}, **kw)
106	
107	    def patch(self, path, data, **kw):
108	        return self.call("PATCH", path, data, **kw)
109	
110	    def delete(self, path, **kw):
111	        return self.call("DELETE", path, **kw)

1	"""Talk to an SAP system through its ADT REST interface.
2	
3	Credentials come from an env file with A4H_USER, A4H_PASSWORD and A4H_CLIENT (default ~/.config/evolve/a4h.env, or
4	SAP_ENV). The base URL is SAP_URL, by default a local SSH tunnel. One Sap object keeps one set of cookies, so it uses
5	one security session on the server instead of one per request.
6	"""
7	import atexit
8	import base64
9	import http.cookiejar
10	import os
11	import re
12	import urllib.error
13	import urllib.parse
14	import urllib.request
15	import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
16	
17	DEFAULT_ENV = "~/.config/evolve/a4h.env"
18	DEFAULT_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:15000"
19	PACKAGE = "$TMP"
20	
21	
22	class SapError(Exception):
23	    pass
24	
25	
26	def load_env(path):
27	    values = {}
28	    with open(os.path.expanduser(path)) as f:
29	        for line in f:
30	            line = line.strip()
31	            if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line:
32	                key, value = line.split("=", 1)
33	                values[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
34	    return values
35	
36	
37	class Sap:
38	    def __init__(self, env=None, url=None):
39	        values = load_env(env or os.environ.get("SAP_ENV", DEFAULT_ENV))
40	        self.user = values["A4H_USER"]
41	        self.client = values["A4H_CLIENT"]
42	        token = base64.b64encode(f"{self.user}:{values['A4H_PASSWORD']}".encode()).decode()
43	        self.auth = "Basic " + token
44	        self.url = (url or os.environ.get("SAP_URL", DEFAULT_URL)).rstrip("/")
45	        self.jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
46	        self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(self.jar))
47	        self.csrf = None
48	        atexit.register(self.logoff)
49	
50	    def logoff(self):
51	        """End the session on the server when the process ends: each user may hold only so many, and an ended
52	        session also releases any lock it held."""
53	        if not len(self.jar):
54	            return
55	        try:
56	            req = urllib.request.Request(f"{self.url}/sap/public/bc/icf/logoff?sap-client={self.client}")
57	            self.opener.open(req, timeout=10).read()
58	        except Exception:
59	            pass
60	        self.jar.clear()
61	
62	    # -- plumbing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
63	
64	    def request(self, method, path, body=None, content_type=None, accept="*/*", stateful=False, retry=True):
65	        url = self.url + path + ("&" if "?" in path else "?") + "sap-client=" + self.client
66	        headers = {"Authorization": self.auth, "Accept": accept, "X-CSRF-Token": self.csrf or "Fetch"}
67	        if content_type:
68	            headers["Content-Type"] = content_type
69	        if stateful:
70	            headers["X-sap-adt-sessiontype"] = "stateful"
71	        data = body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else body
72	        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers=headers)
73	        try:
74	            with self.opener.open(req, timeout=300) as resp:
75	                self.csrf = resp.headers.get("x-csrf-token", self.csrf)
76	                return resp.status, resp.headers, resp.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
77	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
78	            text = e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
79	            if e.code == 403 and retry and "csrf" in (e.headers.get("x-csrf-token", "") + text).lower():
80	                self.csrf = None
81	                self.fetch_csrf()
82	                return self.request(method, path, body, content_type, accept, stateful, retry=False)
83	            if e.code == 400 and retry and not stateful and "Session Timed Out or Not Found" in text:
84	                # The server dropped this session (after a short dump, for one): start a new one.
85	                self.jar.clear()
86	                self.csrf = None
87	                self.fetch_csrf()
88	                return self.request(method, path, body, content_type, accept, stateful, retry=False)
89	            raise SapError(f"{method} {path}: HTTP {e.code}: {short(text)}") from None
90	
91	    def fetch_csrf(self):
92	        self.request("GET", "/sap/bc/adt/discovery", accept="application/atomsvc+xml")
93	
94	    def post(self, path, body="", **kw):
95	        if not self.csrf:
96	            self.fetch_csrf()
97	        return self.request("POST", path, body, **kw)
98	
99	    # -- reading ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
100	
101	    def sql(self, query, rows=5000):
102	        """Run an Open SQL SELECT through the data preview and return a list of dicts (values as strings)."""
103	        _, _, text = self.post(f"/sap/bc/adt/datapreview/freestyle?rowNumber={rows}", query,
104	                               content_type="text/plain", accept="application/xml, application/vnd.sap.adt.datapreview.table.v1+xml")
105	        root = ET.fromstring(text)
106	        columns = []
107	        for col in root.iter():
108	            if local(col.tag) != "columns":
109	                continue
110	            name, values = None, []
111	            for child in col:
112	                if local(child.tag) == "metadata":
113	                    name = attr(child, "name")
114	                elif local(child.tag) == "dataSet":
115	                    values = [(d.text or "") for d in child]
116	            columns.append((name, values))
117	        count = max((len(v) for _, v in columns), default=0)
118	        return [{name: values[i].rstrip() for name, values in columns} for i in range(count)]
119	
120	    def source(self, uri):
121	        _, _, text = self.request("GET", uri, accept="text/plain")
122	        return text
123	
124	    def program_source(self, name):
125	        return self.source(f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/programs/{q(name)}/source/main")
126	
127	    def include_source(self, name):
128	        return self.source(f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/includes/{q(name)}/source/main")
129	
130	    # -- writing and running ABAP -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
131	
132	    def write_program(self, name, source, description="Proof Port helper"):
133	        """Create the report if needed, replace its source and activate it. Local objects only ($TMP)."""
134	        uri = f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/programs/{q(name)}"
135	        if not self.exists(uri):
136	            body = (
137	                '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>'
138	                '<program:abapProgram xmlns:program="http://www.sap.com/adt/programs/programs" '
139	                'xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core" '
140	                f'adtcore:description="{description}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}" adtcore:type="PROG/P" '
141	                f'adtcore:responsible="{self.user}">'
142	                f'<adtcore:packageRef adtcore:name="{PACKAGE}"/></program:abapProgram>'
143	            )
144	            self.post("/sap/bc/adt/programs/programs", body,
145	                      content_type="application/vnd.sap.adt.programs.programs.v2+xml")
146	        _, _, text = self.post(f"{uri}?_action=LOCK&accessMode=MODIFY", stateful=True,
147	                               accept="application/vnd.sap.as+xml;charset=UTF-8;dataname=com.sap.adt.lock.result")
148	        handle = urllib.parse.quote(re.search(r"<LOCK_HANDLE>(.*?)</LOCK_HANDLE>", text).group(1), safe="")
149	        try:
150	            self.request("PUT", f"{uri}/source/main?lockHandle={handle}", source,
151	                         content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8", stateful=True)
152	        finally:
153	            try:
154	                self.post(f"{uri}?_action=UNLOCK&lockHandle={handle}", stateful=True)
155	            except SapError as e:
156	                print(f"warning: unlock of {name} failed: {e}")
157	        self.activate(uri, name)
158	
159	    def activate(self, uri, name):
160	        body = (
161	            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>'
162	            '<adtcore:objectReferences xmlns:adtcore="http://www.sap.com/adt/core">'
163	            f'<adtcore:objectReference adtcore:uri="{uri}" adtcore:name="{name.upper()}"/>'
164	            '</adtcore:objectReferences>'
165	        )
166	        _, _, text = self.post("/sap/bc/adt/activation?method=activate&preauditRequested=true", body,
167	                               content_type="application/xml")
168	        errors = re.findall(r'<msg[^>]*type="E"[^>]*>.*?<txt>(.*?)</txt>', text, re.S)
169	        if errors:
170	            raise SapError(f"activating {name}: " + " | ".join(errors))
171	
172	    def exists(self, uri):
173	        try:
174	            self.request("GET", uri, accept="application/vnd.sap.adt.programs.programs.v2+xml, application/xml")
175	            return True
176	        except SapError as e:
177	            if "HTTP 404" in str(e):
178	                return False
179	            raise
180	
181	    def run_program(self, name):
182	        """Run a report without a selection screen and return its list output as text."""
183	        _, _, text = self.post(f"/sap/bc/adt/programs/programrun/{q(name)}", accept="text/plain")
184	        return text
185	
186	    def run_abap(self, source, name="ZPP_RUN"):
187	        self.write_program(name, source)
188	        return self.run_program(name)
189	
190	
191	def local(tag):
192	    return tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
193	
194	
195	def attr(el, name):
196	    for key, value in el.attrib.items():
197	        if local(key) == name:
198	            return value
199	    return None
200	
201	
202	def q(name):
203	    return urllib.parse.quote(name.lower(), safe="")
204	
205	
206	def short(text, n=400):
207	    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
208	    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()[:n]
209

*"* Behaviour pool of ZPP_MM_R_ARTICLE: the checks and the derived values of the
*"* old module pool SAPMZRET_ART (transaction ZMM01).
*"*
*"* Where each old rule lives now:
*"*   MODULE check_0210 (name, type, default base UoM)  -> prepareSave + checkArticle
*"*   MODULE check_0220 (price, default currency)       -> prepareSave + checkArticle
*"*   FORM   check_all  (all of them, then the variants) -> checkArticle
*"*   FORM   save_article (variant currency, header EAN,
*"*          created by/on, changed by/on)              -> prepareSave

CLASS lhc_article DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS get_global_authorizations FOR GLOBAL AUTHORIZATION
      IMPORTING REQUEST requested_authorizations FOR article RESULT result.

    METHODS preparesave FOR DETERMINE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR article~preparesave.

    METHODS checkarticle FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR article~checkarticle.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS lhc_article IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_global_authorizations.
    IF requested_authorizations-%create = if_abap_behv=>mk-on.
      result-%create = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed.
    ENDIF.
    IF requested_authorizations-%update = if_abap_behv=>mk-on.
      result-%update = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed.
    ENDIF.
    IF requested_authorizations-%delete = if_abap_behv=>mk-on.
      result-%delete = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD preparesave.

    DATA lt_variant_upd TYPE TABLE FOR UPDATE zpp_mm_r_article\\variant.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY article
        ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
        RESULT DATA(lt_article).

    LOOP AT lt_article INTO DATA(ls_article).

      READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY article BY \_variant
          ALL FIELDS WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_article-%tky ) )
          RESULT DATA(lt_variant).
      SORT lt_variant BY screenrow variantid.

      " MODULE check_0210 / check_0220: only the subscreen that was open when Save
      " was pressed fills in its own default. Saving from another tab leaves the
      " field as the user left it, empty included.
      DATA(lv_base_uom) = ls_article-baseuom.
      DATA(lv_currency) = ls_article-currency.
      IF ls_article-savetab = 'TAB1' AND lv_base_uom IS INITIAL.
        lv_base_uom = 'ST'.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_article-savetab = 'TAB2' AND lv_currency IS INITIAL.
        lv_currency = 'EUR'.
      ENDIF.

      " FORM save_article: a variant with no currency of its own takes the header's.
      CLEAR lt_variant_upd.
      LOOP AT lt_variant INTO DATA(ls_variant) WHERE currency IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky     = ls_variant-%tky
                        currency = lv_currency ) TO lt_variant_upd.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lt_variant_upd IS NOT INITIAL.
        MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
          ENTITY variant
            UPDATE FIELDS ( currency ) WITH lt_variant_upd
          REPORTED DATA(lt_ignore_variant).
      ENDIF.

      " FORM save_article: the header EAN is the EAN of the first variant that has
      " one, in row order; without such a variant the header keeps none. The old
      " program re-derives it on every save, because the screen structure carries
      " no EAN of its own.
      DATA lv_ean TYPE zret_t_article-ean.
      CLEAR lv_ean.
      LOOP AT lt_variant INTO ls_variant.
        IF ls_variant-variantid IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_variant-ean IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_ean = ls_variant-ean.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      " FORM save_article: created by/on survive a change, changed by/on are always
      " stamped.
      DATA(lv_created_by) = ls_article-createdby.
      DATA(lv_created_on) = ls_article-createdon.
      IF lv_created_by IS INITIAL AND lv_created_on IS INITIAL.
        lv_created_by = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_technical_name( ).
        lv_created_on = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).
      ENDIF.

      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY article
          UPDATE FIELDS ( baseuom currency ean createdby createdon changedby changedon )
          WITH VALUE #( ( %tky      = ls_article-%tky
                          baseuom   = lv_base_uom
                          currency  = lv_currency
                          ean       = lv_ean
                          createdby = lv_created_by
                          createdon = lv_created_on
                          changedby = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_technical_name( )
                          changedon = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ) ) )
        REPORTED DATA(lt_ignore_article).

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD checkarticle.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY article
        ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
        RESULT DATA(lt_article).

    LOOP AT lt_article INTO DATA(ls_article).

      READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY article BY \_variant
          ALL FIELDS WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_article-%tky ) )
          RESULT DATA(lt_variant).
      SORT lt_variant BY screenrow variantid.

      DATA lv_text TYPE string.
      CLEAR lv_text.

      " The open subscreen's own PAI module runs before FORM check_all, so saving
      " from the price tab reports a bad price before a missing name. From the
      " other two tabs check_all alone decides, and its order is name, type,
      " price, then the variants row by row.
      IF ls_article-savetab = 'TAB2' AND ls_article-price <= 0.
        lv_text = 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-articlename IS INITIAL.
        lv_text = 'Renseignez le nom de l''article'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-articletype IS INITIAL.
        lv_text = 'Choisissez un type d''article'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-price <= 0.
        lv_text = 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_text IS INITIAL.
        LOOP AT lt_variant INTO DATA(ls_variant).
          " A row the user never touched is not a variant at all; the old loop
          " skips any row without an identifier and without an EAN.
          IF ls_variant-variantid IS INITIAL AND ls_variant-ean IS INITIAL.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.
          DATA(lv_row) = COND i( WHEN ls_variant-screenrow > 0
                                 THEN ls_variant-screenrow
                                 ELSE sy-tabix ).
          IF ls_variant-variantid IS INITIAL.
            lv_text = |Variante ligne { lv_row } : identifiant manquant|.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          IF ls_variant-ean IS NOT INITIAL
             AND ( strlen( ls_variant-ean ) <> 13 OR ls_variant-ean(13) CN '0123456789' ).
            lv_text = |Variante ligne { lv_row } : l'EAN doit avoir 13 chiffres|.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.

      " The old screen stops at its first MESSAGE ... TYPE 'E', so exactly one
      " message comes back.
      IF lv_text IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_article-%tky ) TO failed-article.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_article-%tky
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = lv_text ) ) TO reported-article.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    METHODS get_global_authorizations FOR GLOBAL AUTHORIZATION
      IMPORTING REQUEST requested_authorizations FOR article RESULT result.

    METHODS preparesave FOR DETERMINE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR article~preparesave.

    METHODS checkarticle FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR article~checkarticle.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS lhc_article IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_global_authorizations.
    IF requested_authorizations-%create = if_abap_behv=>mk-on.
      result-%create = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed.
    ENDIF.
    IF requested_authorizations-%update = if_abap_behv=>mk-on.
      result-%update = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed.
    ENDIF.
    IF requested_authorizations-%delete = if_abap_behv=>mk-on.
      result-%delete = if_abap_behv=>auth-allowed.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD preparesave.

    DATA lt_variant_upd TYPE TABLE FOR UPDATE zpp_mm_r_article\\variant.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY article
        ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
        RESULT DATA(lt_article).

    LOOP AT lt_article INTO DATA(ls_article).

      READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY article BY \_variant
          ALL FIELDS WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_article-%tky ) )
          RESULT DATA(lt_variant).
      SORT lt_variant BY screenrow variantid.

      " MODULE check_0210 / check_0220: only the subscreen that was open when Save
      " was pressed fills in its own default. Saving from another tab leaves the
      " field as the user left it, empty included.
      DATA(lv_base_uom) = ls_article-baseuom.
      DATA(lv_currency) = ls_article-currency.
      IF ls_article-savetab = 'TAB1' AND lv_base_uom IS INITIAL.
        lv_base_uom = 'ST'.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_article-savetab = 'TAB2' AND lv_currency IS INITIAL.
        lv_currency = 'EUR'.
      ENDIF.

      " FORM save_article: a variant with no currency of its own takes the header's.
      CLEAR lt_variant_upd.
      LOOP AT lt_variant INTO DATA(ls_variant) WHERE currency IS INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky     = ls_variant-%tky
                        currency = lv_currency ) TO lt_variant_upd.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lt_variant_upd IS NOT INITIAL.
        MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
          ENTITY variant
            UPDATE FIELDS ( currency ) WITH lt_variant_upd
          REPORTED DATA(lt_ignore_variant).
      ENDIF.

      " FORM save_article: the header EAN is the EAN of the first variant that has
      " one, in row order; without such a variant the header keeps none. The old
      " program re-derives it on every save, because the screen structure carries
      " no EAN of its own.
      DATA lv_ean TYPE zret_t_article-ean.
      CLEAR lv_ean.
      LOOP AT lt_variant INTO ls_variant.
        IF ls_variant-variantid IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_variant-ean IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_ean = ls_variant-ean.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      " FORM save_article: created by/on survive a change, changed by/on are always
      " stamped.
      DATA(lv_created_by) = ls_article-createdby.
      DATA(lv_created_on) = ls_article-createdon.
      IF lv_created_by IS INITIAL AND lv_created_on IS INITIAL.
        lv_created_by = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_technical_name( ).
        lv_created_on = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).
      ENDIF.

      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY article
          UPDATE FIELDS ( baseuom currency ean createdby createdon changedby changedon )
          WITH VALUE #( ( %tky      = ls_article-%tky
                          baseuom   = lv_base_uom
                          currency  = lv_currency
                          ean       = lv_ean
                          createdby = lv_created_by
                          createdon = lv_created_on
                          changedby = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_technical_name( )
                          changedon = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ) ) )
        REPORTED DATA(lt_ignore_article).

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD checkarticle.

    READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY article
        ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
        RESULT DATA(lt_article).

    LOOP AT lt_article INTO DATA(ls_article).

      READ ENTITIES OF zpp_mm_r_article IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY article BY \_variant
          ALL FIELDS WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_article-%tky ) )
          RESULT DATA(lt_variant).
      SORT lt_variant BY screenrow variantid.

      DATA lv_text TYPE string.
      CLEAR lv_text.

      " The open subscreen's own PAI module runs before FORM check_all, so saving
      " from the price tab reports a bad price before a missing name. From the
      " other two tabs check_all alone decides, and its order is name, type,
      " price, then the variants row by row.
      IF ls_article-savetab = 'TAB2' AND ls_article-price <= 0.
        lv_text = 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-articlename IS INITIAL.
        lv_text = 'Renseignez le nom de l''article'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-articletype IS INITIAL.
        lv_text = 'Choisissez un type d''article'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-price <= 0.
        lv_text = 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_text IS INITIAL.
        LOOP AT lt_variant INTO DATA(ls_variant).
          " A row the user never touched is not a variant at all; the old loop
          " skips any row without an identifier and without an EAN.
          IF ls_variant-variantid IS INITIAL AND ls_variant-ean IS INITIAL.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.
          DATA(lv_row) = COND i( WHEN ls_variant-screenrow > 0
                                 THEN ls_variant-screenrow
                                 ELSE sy-tabix ).
          IF ls_variant-variantid IS INITIAL.
            lv_text = |Variante ligne { lv_row } : identifiant manquant|.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          IF ls_variant-ean IS NOT INITIAL
             AND ( strlen( ls_variant-ean ) <> 13 OR ls_variant-ean(13) CN '0123456789' ).
            lv_text = |Variante ligne { lv_row } : l'EAN doit avoir 13 chiffres|.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.

      " The old screen stops at its first MESSAGE ... TYPE 'E', so exactly one
      " message comes back.
      IF lv_text IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_article-%tky ) TO failed-article.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_article-%tky
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = lv_text ) ) TO reported-article.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

This command requires approval

1	"""After the port: did the port agent see the sealed cases?
2	
3	Looks at what the agent did and wrote, not at what the factory showed it: every tool call it made, every message it
4	wrote, and every file in its port folder. Flags any tool call that touches the sealed cases, the test author's work
5	or the vault; any sealed case intent it repeats; and any sealed case id it writes that the public factory files don't
6	already contain as an example. Also checks the new objects and the driver for calls into the old transaction.
7	
8	    python3 factory/check.py ZCRED
9	"""
10	import json
11	import os
12	import re
13	import sys
14	
15	ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
16	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
17	import vault  # noqa: E402
18	
19	CASE_ID = re.compile(r"(?<![\w-])c\d{3}(?![\w-])")
20	AS_ID = re.compile(r'"id\\?"\s*:\s*\\?"(c\d{3})\\?"')  # used as a case's id, in JSON or in JSON inside JSON
21	ACCESS_TOOLS = ("Read", "Glob", "Grep", "Bash", "Edit", "NotebookEdit")
22	TOUCH = re.compile(r"sealed|/work\b|/work/|proof-port-vault|bundle\.json|tests_transcript", re.I)
23	FORBIDDEN_ABAP = [r"CALL\s+TRANSACTION", r"\bSUBMIT\b", r"PERFORM\s+\w+\s+IN\s+PROGRAM", r"BDCDATA", r"SAPMZ\w+"]
24	FORBIDDEN_DRIVER = [r"^\s*(import|from)\s+(sap|abap|oracle|grade)\b", r"urllib\.request", r"http\.client", r"\bsocket\b",
25	                    r"\brequests\b", r"subprocess", r"\bopen\(", r"run_program", r"run_abap", r"\.sql\("]
26	
27	
28	def sealed_bundle(tcode):
29	    for base in (os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "sealed"), os.path.join(vault.VAULT, tcode, "sealed")):
30	        path = os.path.join(base, "bundle.json")
31	        if os.path.exists(path):
32	            with open(path) as f:
33	                return json.load(f)
34	    raise SystemExit("no sealed bundle found")
35	
36	
37	def agent_output(tcode):
38	    """(where, text) for everything the agent produced: tool inputs, its own words, its files."""
39	    out = []
40	    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "logs", "port_transcript.jsonl")) as f:
41	        for line in f:
42	            try:
43	                e = json.loads(line)
44	            except ValueError:
45	                continue
46	            if e.get("type") != "assistant":
47	                continue
48	            for c in e["message"].get("content", []):
49	                if c.get("type") == "tool_use":
50	                    out.append((f"tool call {c['name']}", json.dumps(c["input"], ensure_ascii=False)))
51	                elif c.get("type") == "text":
52	                    out.append(("agent's words", c["text"]))
53	    port = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port")
54	    for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(port):
55	        for name in files:
56	            path = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
57	            with open(path, errors="replace") as f:
58	                out.append((os.path.relpath(path, ROOT), f.read()))
59	    return out
60	
61	
62	def public_ids():
63	    ids = set()
64	    for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(os.path.join(ROOT, "factory")):
65	        for name in files:
66	            if name.endswith((".py", ".md")):
67	                with open(os.path.join(dirpath, name)) as f:
68	                    ids |= set(CASE_ID.findall(f.read()))
69	    return ids
70	
71	
72	def main(tcode):
73	    bundle = sealed_bundle(tcode)
74	    sealed_ids = {c["id"] for c in bundle["cases"]}
75	    intents = [c["intent"] for c in bundle["cases"] if len(c.get("intent", "")) > 30]
76	    examples = public_ids()
77	    leaks, notes = [], []
78	    for where, text in agent_output(tcode):
79	        if where.startswith("tool call") and where.split()[-1] in ACCESS_TOOLS:
80	            for m in TOUCH.finditer(text):
81	                excluded = "-not -path" in text[max(0, m.start() - 16):m.start()]
82	                (notes if excluded else leaks).append(f"{where} {'excludes' if excluded else 'touches'} "
83	                                                     f"{m.group(0)}: {text[:160]}")
84	        ids = sorted((set(AS_ID.findall(text)) & sealed_ids) - examples)
85	        if ids:
86	            leaks.append(f"{where}: sealed case ids {ids[:10]}")
87	        for intent in intents:
88	            if intent in text:
89	                leaks.append(f"{where}: repeats the intent of a sealed case: {intent[:80]}")
90	    calls = []
91	    src = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port", "src")
92	    for name in sorted(os.listdir(src)) if os.path.isdir(src) else []:
93	        with open(os.path.join(src, name), errors="replace") as f:
94	            text = f.read()
95	        calls += [f"{name}: {p}" for p in FORBIDDEN_ABAP if re.search(p, text, re.I)]
96	    driver = os.path.join(ROOT, "runs", tcode, "port", "driver.py")
97	    if os.path.exists(driver):
98	        with open(driver) as f:
99	            text = f.read()
100	        calls += [f"driver.py: {p}" for p in FORBIDDEN_DRIVER if re.search(p, text, re.M)]
101	    result = {"sealed_cases": len(sealed_ids), "leaks": leaks, "notes": notes, "forbidden_calls": calls}
102	    print(json.dumps(result, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
103	    return result
104	
105	
106	if __name__ == "__main__":
107	    r = main(sys.argv[1].upper())
108	    sys.exit(1 if r["leaks"] or r["forbidden_calls"] else 0)

      DATA lv_text TYPE string.
      CLEAR lv_text.

      " The open subscreen's own PAI module runs before FORM check_all, so saving
      " from the price tab reports a bad price before a missing name. From the
      " other two tabs check_all alone decides, and its order is name, type,
      " price, then the variants row by row.
      IF ls_article-savetab = 'TAB2' AND ls_article-price <= 0.
        lv_text = 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-articlename IS INITIAL.
        lv_text = 'Renseignez le nom de l''article'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-articletype IS INITIAL.
        lv_text = 'Choisissez un type d''article'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_text IS INITIAL AND ls_article-price <= 0.
        lv_text = 'Le prix doit être supérieur à zéro'.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_text IS INITIAL.
        LOOP AT lt_variant INTO DATA(ls_variant).
          " A row the user never touched is not a variant at all; the old loop
          " skips any row without an identifier and without an EAN.
          IF ls_variant-variantid IS INITIAL AND ls_variant-ean IS INITIAL.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.
          DATA(lv_row) = COND i( WHEN ls_variant-screenrow > 0
                                 THEN ls_variant-screenrow
                                 ELSE sy-tabix ).
          IF ls_variant-variantid IS INITIAL.
            lv_text = |Variante ligne { lv_row } : identifiant manquant|.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          IF ls_variant-ean IS NOT INITIAL
             AND ( strlen( ls_variant-ean ) <> 13 OR ls_variant-ean(13) CN '0123456789' ).
            lv_text = |Variante ligne { lv_row } : l'EAN doit avoir 13 chiffres|.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.

      " The old screen stops at its first MESSAGE ... TYPE 'E', so exactly one
      " message comes back.
      IF lv_text IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_article-%tky ) TO failed-article.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_article-%tky
                        %msg = new_message_with_text(
                                 severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                                 text     = lv_text ) ) TO reported-article.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
